title: Plumbing Software: 7 Tools Compared by Price and Job Limits
html:
Plumbing software is priced three ways, and the way you pay matters more than the headline price. Some tools charge per user, some cap jobs per month and some publish no price at all. Pick the model that fits your crew, and pair it with plumbing lead generation so the board stays full. Published plans in this guide run from $0 to $627 a month. Pair your software with a weekly LSA call review if you buy Local Services Ads leads.

Plumbing software has to handle the call that cannot wait: a burst pipe at night, a backed-up drain, a water heater out on a Sunday. The tool needs to book the job, send a plumber and send an invoice before the customer calls the next company. This guide covers seven tools, how each one charges and one real limit for each.

Plumbers face a pricing problem other trades do not. A crew of three might run 200 small jobs a month, while a crew of three roofers runs ten. A tool that charges per job can cost more than a tool that charges per user, or the reverse. So this guide shows the break-even points from the vendors' own prices.

Which plumbing software caps your jobs instead of your users?

ServiceM8 prices by the number of jobs you run each month and lets every paid plan have unlimited users. That suits a plumbing company with several plumbers and a modest job count.

  • ServiceM8: the Free plan is $0 for 1 user and 30 jobs a month. Starter is $29 a month for 50 jobs. Growing is $79 for 150 jobs, and Premium is $149 for 500 jobs. Premium Plus is $349 for 1,500 or more. All paid plans have unlimited users. Limit: Premium Plus charges 20 cents for each job over the cap, and the page shows monthly prices only.

Count your jobs before you look at the price. A plumbing company with six plumbers that closes 250 jobs a month fits Premium at $149 for 500 jobs. The same company on a per-user plan pays by headcount instead. The page says you can keep working for 7 days past your cap before it asks you to upgrade.

Plumbing has many tiny jobs, such as a faucet or a toilet flapper, and each counts. If most of your tickets are small, a job cap fills faster than you expect. Pull last quarter's invoice count before you pick a tier.

What plumbing business software charges per user?

Tradify charges per user each month, and Workiz sells tiers by feature. Both fit crews that grow by adding plumbers rather than jobs.

  • Tradify: Lite is $47, Pro is $51 and Plus is $61, each per user per month in USD. A custom plan is by request. Limit: SmartTools is available on Plus only, and the Instant Website add-on is $12 a month on top.
  • Workiz: lists Standard, Pro and Ultimate plans with 5, 10 and 30 automations. Ultimate adds flat rate pricing, multi-day jobs, sales proposals and inventory management. Limit: the page shows no plan prices and sends you to a demo, and add-ons such as Genius Answering are also unpriced.

Flat rate pricing matters in plumbing because many shops quote a fixed price for a repair. On Workiz, flat rate sits on Ultimate, not on Standard or Pro. Check that the plan you buy includes the pricing method you use.

The Tradify math is simple. Four plumbers on Lite cost $188 a month, on Pro $204 and on Plus $244. Six plumbers on Lite cost $282. Per-user pricing is predictable, but it grows with every hire and every seasonal helper.

Which plumbing field service software gives unlimited users?

Service Fusion includes unlimited users on every plan, which makes the bill flat as you hire. ServiceTitan goes the other way and prices per technician on request.

  • Service Fusion: Starter is $208 a month billed annually or $245 month to month. Plus is $325 annual or $382 monthly, and Pro is $533 annual or $627 monthly. Limit: job costing, inventory and a customer portal sit in higher tiers or add-ons, and add-on prices are not listed.
  • ServiceTitan: lists Starter, Essentials and The Works. Starter includes dispatching, scheduling, call booking, invoicing and a pricebook, and Essentials adds mobile estimates. Limit: pricing is per technician and quoted on request, so you cannot budget before a demo.

Compare the flat model with the per-user model. Service Fusion Starter at $208 is cheaper than Tradify Plus for four plumbers at $244, but more than Tradify Lite at $188. At five plumbers, Tradify Lite is $235, so Service Fusion Starter wins. Past five plumbers, unlimited users pull ahead.

ServiceTitan suits a plumbing company with dispatchers and a call center. A three-van shop rarely needs it. Ask for a written quote and compare it with the published prices above before you book a long demo.

Which accounting software fits a plumbing business?

QuickBooks Online is the accounting tool most field service apps connect to, and its published plans lists four plans.

  • QuickBooks Online: Simple Start shows $19 a month under a 50% off for 3 months promotion, struck through from $38. Essentials shows $42.50, Plus $70 and Advanced $170 on the same promotion. Simple Start covers 1 user, Essentials 3, Plus 5 and Advanced 25. Limit: the promotion ends after 3 months, so budget for the struck-through price.

Many plumbing shops run a field service app for jobs and QuickBooks for the books. Ask whether your job app syncs invoices and payments. If it does not, someone will retype every invoice each week.

What free tool gets a plumber found in emergency searches?

Google Business Profile is the free listing that shows a plumbing company in Google Maps when someone searches for a plumber nearby. Google states that you can add or claim your business at no charge.

  • Google Business Profile: shows your name, service area, phone number, hours and reviews. Limit: it only helps when the address is accurate and the profile gets fresh photos, posts and review replies.

Emergency searches happen on a phone, so the call button and the hours matter most.

ServiceM8Jobs per month$0 to $349 a monthJob caps by tier
TradifyPer user$47 to $61 per user a monthCost grows with each hire
WorkizTiers by featureNot publishedAdd-ons not priced
Service FusionFlat, unlimited users$208 to $533 a month, billed annuallyAdd-ons not priced
ServiceTitanPer technicianNot publishedNeeds a demo to price
QuickBooks OnlinePer plan$19 to $170 on promotionPromotion ends after 3 months
Google Business ProfileFree$0Needs steady upkeep

How much does plumbing software cost for a six-plumber company?

A six-plumber company running 250 jobs a month has three sensible options with published prices. ServiceM8 Premium is $149 a month for up to 500 jobs and unlimited users. Service Fusion Starter is $208 a month billed annually. Tradify Lite is $282 for six users. Workiz and ServiceTitan need quotes.

Add QuickBooks Essentials at its struck-through price of $85 for 3 users. The totals become about $234 with ServiceM8, $293 with Service Fusion and $367 with Tradify.

The cheapest bill is not always the best fit. ServiceM8 Premium costs least here, but a month with 600 jobs pushes the company toward the next tier. Service Fusion costs more, but it will not change as you add crews. Tradify costs most at six users, yet it lets you add or drop a seat by the month.

Processing fees can matter more than the plan. Every tool here may charge for card payments, and rates are on each vendor's own page. Ask each one for the rate on your average ticket.

What should you ask a plumbing software vendor before you sign?

Ask five questions in the demo and write down the answers. Vendors change plans often, so a written answer beats the page you read today.

Run the night-call test in the free trial if one exists. Workiz lists a 7 day trial, and Tradify lists 14 days. If the app slows down a late-night booking, it will slow you down on your busiest day.

What does plumbing software not do for you?

Plumbing software organizes jobs after the phone rings. It does not rank your website, run ads or fill a slow week, and none of the tools above does those things.

Your website needs a call button, service pages and fast mobile loading. It is a managed build, not a template you edit yourself.

How do you choose plumbing software for your company?

Choose plumbing software with a three-check filter: fit, cost and setup effort. Run every tool through all three before you pay.

Fit: does the pricing model match your crew and job count, and does it support the way you quote, flat rate or time and materials?

Cost: add the plan price, extra seats, job overage and card fees, then compare the total with your average ticket.

Setup effort: can the office import customers and a price list in a week, or does it need paid onboarding?

A one-plumber owner can run on ServiceM8 Free or Starter and a free Google Business Profile. The cost is $0 to $29 a month. A crew of three to five fits Tradify or ServiceM8 Growing. A company past five plumbers should compare Service Fusion and ServiceM8 Premium. A fleet with dispatchers should book a ServiceTitan demo.

Plan the switch around your calendar. Move the office onto a new app during a slow week, not during a cold snap when pipes freeze. Enter open jobs first, then your price list, then your customers. Keep the old system open for a month in case a callback needs history.

Software works hardest when calls keep coming. For a related trade, read the junk removal software guide.

What software does a plumbing company need?

A plumbing company needs a way to book calls, dispatch plumbers, quote jobs and take payment. It also needs a Google Business Profile so customers can find it. Start with one job app sized to your crew, then add accounting sync once invoices pile up.

How much does plumbing software cost?

Published plans here run from $0 for ServiceM8 Free to $627 a month for Service Fusion Pro billed monthly. Tradify charges $47 to $61 per user. Workiz and ServiceTitan publish no price. Processing fees and add-ons cost more, so confirm the total for your crew.

Is ServiceM8 or Tradify better for a plumber?

ServiceM8 caps jobs per month and allows unlimited users on paid plans, while Tradify charges per user. A small crew with many jobs may prefer Tradify. A larger crew with fewer jobs may prefer ServiceM8. Compare both at your real headcount and job count.

Is Service Fusion cheaper than per-user plumbing software?

At five or more plumbers, often yes. Service Fusion Starter is $208 a month billed annually with unlimited users. Tradify Lite is $47 per user, which reaches $235 at five users. Below four users, per-user plans can cost less, so compare at your headcount.

Is Google Business Profile free for a plumbing company?

Google states that you can add or claim your business at no charge. It still takes work: accurate service areas, photos of finished jobs and replies to every review. Google's paid ad products, such as Local Service Ads, are separate and carry their own costs.

What should a new plumbing company buy first?

Set up a free Google Business Profile and a simple website first, because calls come before dispatch. Then add one job app sized to your crew. Add accounting sync once invoices pile up. Skip fleet platforms until several vans share one board.

add the plan price, extra seats, job overage and card fees, then compare the total with your average ticket.
Setup effort:
can the office import customers and a price list in a week, or does it need paid onboarding?
A one-plumber owner can run on ServiceM8 Free or Starter and a free Google Business Profile. The cost is $0 to $29 a month. A crew of three to five fits Tradify or ServiceM8 Growing. A company past five plumbers should compare Service Fusion and ServiceM8 Premium. A fleet with dispatchers should book a ServiceTitan demo.
Plan the switch around your calendar. Move the office onto a new app during a slow week, not during a cold snap when pipes freeze. Enter open jobs first, then your price list, then your customers. Keep the old system open for a month in case a callback needs history.

###
What software does a plumbing company need?
A plumbing company needs a way to book calls, dispatch plumbers, quote jobs and take payment. It also needs a Google Business Profile so customers can find it. Start with one job app sized to your crew, then add accounting sync once invoices pile up.
###
How much does plumbing software cost?
Published plans here run from $0 for ServiceM8 Free to $627 a month for Service Fusion Pro billed monthly. Tradify charges $47 to $61 per user. Workiz and ServiceTitan publish no price. Processing fees and add-ons cost more, so confirm the total for your crew.
###
Is ServiceM8 or Tradify better for a plumber?
ServiceM8 caps jobs per month and allows unlimited users on paid plans, while Tradify charges per user. A small crew with many jobs may prefer Tradify. A larger crew with fewer jobs may prefer ServiceM8. Compare both at your real headcount and job count.
###
Is Service Fusion cheaper than per-user plumbing software?
At five or more plumbers, often yes. Service Fusion Starter is $208 a month billed annually with unlimited users. Tradify Lite is $47 per user, which reaches $235 at five users. Below four users, per-user plans can cost less, so compare at your headcount.
###
Is Google Business Profile free for a plumbing company?
Google states that you can add or claim your business at no charge. It still takes work: accurate service areas, photos of finished jobs and replies to every review. Google's paid ad products, such as Local Service Ads, are separate and carry their own costs.
###
What should a new plumbing company buy first?
Set up a free Google Business Profile and a simple website first, because calls come before dispatch. Then add one job app sized to your crew. Add accounting sync once invoices pile up. Skip fleet platforms until several vans share one board.
